decision.summary: The prolonged E/U descent from ~500–664 lacks any opposing return and shows monotonic trend behavior—consistent with a unidirectional offset or trend, not a temporary offset. The sharp multi-axis displacement at index 684 is the only candidate for a temporary offset, but its return is unobserved within the allowed context (ends at 699), and the post-event plateau persists to the end of data. Hence, only one uncertain temporary interval is identified.

intervals.observation: E-component drops sharply at index 684 (−10.998 MAD), U rises (+6.848 MAD) and N jumps later (+26.176 MAD); all three axes show a new plateau after ~685–690 with no opposing return observed within allowed context [465,699]. Return not observed; status uncertain.
